title: How to Calculate Your Freelance Hourly Rate
description: Calculate the right freelance hourly rate by factoring expenses, taxes, billable hours and desired income.
content:
Why Calculate Your Rate Properly

Many freelancers undercharge. Calculate based on your actual needs, not just market rates.

Formula

(Desired Annual Income + Expenses + Taxes) / Billable Hours Per Year = Hourly Rate

Steps

  1. Set your desired take-home income
  2. Calculate annual business expenses
  3. Estimate taxes
  4. Calculate billable hours (less vacation, admin, marketing)
  5. Divide total needed by billable hours
